artboards.title: Sort A · one row, as promised
Reminders A · card with Not now
Reminders B · ask at the first timed capture
Onboarding B · three cards, first one live

annotations.text:
SORT
Today the rail is Today · Someday · Tomorrow · This week · Event · Note, scrolling, with no Done and no Drop. Onboarding promises Today, Done, Keep, Drop.

A: one row. Three dates plus Done and Drop as icons. Nothing scrolls; type changes live behind the chevron. Tradeoff: no This week.

B: every answer visible on two lines. Tradeoff: taller cards, fewer per screen.

Either way: one name. The tab says Sort, the sheet and Details say Inbox. Sort everywhere.

REMINDERS
Today the card is the third onboarding screen and then sits above every day, forever.

A: the card names the item that needs it and has Not now. After Not now it collapses to one quiet line, gone once granted.

B: no card at all. The first time something is saved with a time, one snackbar asks. Tradeoff: a user who never types a time is never asked, which is correct.

ONBOARDING
Today: three passive cards, then Start capturing lands on an empty page with the keyboard down.

A: one screen with the real bar, prefilled, chips live. Retype it, see it change, start. The Sort and Reminders cards go: Sort explains itself the first time something has no date, reminders are asked for per B.

B: keep three cards but make the first one live. Safer, longer.
